# akeyless_dynamic_secret_artifactory (Resource)

Artifactory dynamic secret resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifactory_token_audience` (String) A space-separate list of the other Artifactory instances or services that should accept this token., for example: jfrt@*
- `artifactory_token_scope` (String) Token scope provided as a space-separated list, for example: member-of-groups:readers
- `name` (String) Dynamic Secret name

### Optional

- `ara_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Agentic Runtime Authority
- `artifactory_admin_name` (String) Admin name
- `artifactory_admin_pwd` (String) Admin API Key/Password
- `artifactory_admin_pwd_wo` (String, Sensitive) artifactory_admin_pwd (write-only, not stored in state). Requires Terraform 1.11+. Bump artifactory_admin_pwd_wo_version to change it.
- `artifactory_admin_pwd_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for artifactory_admin_pwd_wo. Increment to update the value.
- `base_url` (String) Artifactory REST URL, must end with artifactory postfix
- `custom_username_template` (String) Customize how temporary usernames are generated using go template
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Protection from accidental deletion of this item
- `description` (String) Description of the object
- `enable_agentic_runtime_authority` (Boolean) Enable Agentic Runtime Authority
- `enable_ai_quorum` (Boolean) Enable AI Quorum
- `encryption_key_name` (String) Encrypt dynamic secret details with following key
- `item_custom_fields` (Map of String) Additional custom fields to associate with the item
- `retry` (Block List, Max: 1) Retry this resource's operations when the error matches error_message_regex or the HTTP status is in retry_on_status_codes. Overrides the provider retry block. See the Customized Retry guide. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retry))
- `skip_dry_run` (Boolean) Skip dry run
- `tags` (Set of String) List of the tags attached to this secret. To specify multiple tags use argument multiple times: -t Tag1 -t Tag2
- `target_name` (String) Name of existing target to use in dynamic secret creation
- `user_ttl` (String) User TTL

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--retry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry`

Optional:

- `error_message_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matched against the error message. If any matches, the operation is retried.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Wait before the first retry, in seconds. The wait doubles on each retry.
- `max_interval_seconds` (Number) Maximum wait between retries, in seconds.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries after the first attempt.
- `retry_on_status_codes` (List of Number) HTTP status codes of the failed API call that trigger a retry, for example 429 or 503.
